Figure 2: A) Treatment-associated log2 fold-changes for 3,905 biofilm-associated genes and 523 SOS-associated genes, extracted from the whole-transcriptome edgeR quasi-likelihood analysis (Chen et al., 2016; doi:10.12688/f1000research.8987.2). The dashed line indicates FDR = 0.05.

B) Distribution of 31 biofilm-associated genes upregulated in treatment across 14 MAGs. C) Distribution of 14 differentially expressed SOS-associated genes across 11 MAGs, comprising 13 upregulated genes and one downregulated gene. Bars indicate gene counts at whole-transcriptome FDR < 0.05.

D) MAG-level concentration of biofilm-associated and SOS responses relative to random expectation, Cobs/E0[C]. Observed Simpson concentration was compared with 100,000 random allocations stratified by eligible-gene count and mean expression, counting each supported contig once. The reference line indicates random expectation. Filled and open circles indicate Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.05 and q ≥ 0.05, respectively, across 24 planned tests. Figure 3: A) Initial-release fractions, I/(I+BF), for cells, polysaccharides and protein, and transmembrane-pressure regrowth lag across three cleaning cycles. I: initial sampling; BF: backflush sampling. Release measurements were reconstructed from published readouts; lag values were taken from the reported table (Myshkevych et al., 2025; doi:10.1016/j.ceja.2025.100796).

B) Composite cleaning-performance score, S = 0.5 z(P) + 0.5 z(L), where P is the mean of the three initial-release fractions and L is regrowth lag in days. Values were standardized across the six membrane-cycle observations. Higher scores indicate preferential initial release and delayed regrowth.

C) Associations of the cleaning score with whole-MAG DNA abundance and biofilm-associated RNA scores for 14 MAGs carrying genes upregulated in treatment. Models included condition or condition plus categorical cycle, with initial and backflush predictors fitted separately (n = 6; residual degrees of freedom 3 and 1). D) Modelled score change following a 50% reduction in Azonexus TBF3/57 whole-MAG DNA abundance, ΔS = β log2(0.5), holding other terms fixed.
